title: Citation-Grounded Answers
briefMd:
# Phase 3 · Citation-Grounded Answers

Legal/compliance blocked launch: answers must cite sources and refuse when context is insufficient.

You author **only the generation prompt**. Retrieval is fixed: whole-document chunks ranked by BM25 with a title boost, top 5.

Required citation format: `[chunk:<id>]` using ids from the retrieved set. Refuse when the answer is not in context. Pass on class A citation (at least 90% of answers in format), grounding, and refusal gates. Class B semantic support is advisory.

**How it runs.** Your prompt is sent verbatim as the system message to a real model (pinned, temperature 0). The user message is the question followed by the retrieved context, one chunk per block as `(id: <id>) <text>`. An answer counts as a refusal when it says "I don't know" (or "cannot answer"). Use the Simulation Lab's Generate preview to see what the model actually writes before you submit.
